keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «블랙홀이 우주선을 끌어당겼다(문제)» 와 «용감한 선택에는 똑똑한 팀워크가 필요하다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the black hole was pulling the ship in) and the lesson (brave choices need smart teamwork). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The black hole began pulling their ship in.
Pip found the perfect angle, and the ship swung away fast.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: Captain Aria and her robot Pip were bringing
to a sick town. To save two weeks, they flew near a black
, but Pip found the perfect angle, and the ship shot away. They reached
just in time, and the town got better. Aria said brave choices need smart

words: something that helps sick people get better
a quicker way to get somewhere
Aria knew it was dangerous, but the town needed the medicine fast.
likely to hurt you or cause trouble
Even light could not escape from it.
to get away from a place
the direction or slant of a line
The ship swung around the edge of the black hole
the outside part or line of something

qs.q: Why did Aria take the dangerous shortcut?
opts: The town needed the medicine fast.
She wanted to see a black hole for fun.
Pip was afraid of the long trip.
evs: Aria knew it was dangerous, but the town needed the medicine fast.
The trip would take three more weeks.
Even light could not escape from it.
They reached Earth just in time, and the people of the town got better.
why: 아리아는 위험하다는 것을 알았지만, 마을에 약이 빨리 필요했어요. 재미로 블랙홀을 보려고 했다는 말은 없어요.
Aria knew it was dangerous, but the town needed the medicine fast. She did not go there for fun.

qs.q: The text says, "Even light could not escape from it." What does this tell us about the black hole?
qs.qko: "Even light could not escape from it."라고 나와요. 이 말은 블랙홀에 대해 무엇을 알려 주나요?
opts: Its pull is so strong that nothing gets away easily.
It is full of bright lights.
It is a quiet and safe place to rest.
evs: Captain Aria and her robot, Pip, were flying home to Earth with medicine for a sick town.
The black hole was pulling them in!
The trip would take three more weeks.
why: 블랙홀이 우주선을 끌어당기고 있었어요. 빛조차 빠져나오지 못할 만큼 끌어당기는 힘이 아주 세다는 뜻이에요.
The black hole was pulling the ship in. Its pull is so strong that even light cannot get away.

qs.q: How did the ship get away from the black hole?
opts: Aria used full engine power, and Pip found the perfect angle.
They waited until the black hole went away.
evs: As they got closer, the ship began to shake.
"There is a shortcut," said Pip. "We can fly near that black hole and save two weeks."
why: 아리아는 엔진을 최대로 켜라고 외쳤고, 핍은 딱 맞는 각도를 찾았어요. 둘이 힘을 합쳐서 빠져나왔어요.
Aria shouted for full engine power, and Pip found the perfect angle. They got away by working together.

ends: Aria and Pip deliver medicine to a town on the Moon.
아리아와 핍이 달에 있는 마을에 약을 전해요.
Pip learns to fly the ship all by itself.
핍이 혼자서 우주선을 조종하는 법을 배워요.

write.src: “We should <u>work together</u> so that <u>we can do hard things</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «해야 할 일 + 그 목적» 으로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do and its purpose in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 한다» 를 쓰세요. (예: so that we finish on time)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what happens. (e.g. so that we finish on time)

img.cover: A small white spaceship swings around the glowing orange edge of a huge swirling black hole, and through the front window a young woman pilot with short silver hair in a red flight suit grips the controls while a round little robot with a dome head and blue blinking lights points ahead with one metal arm.

scenes.1: Inside the shaking cockpit of a small white spaceship, a young woman pilot with short silver hair in a red flight suit holds the controls tightly and a round little robot with a dome head and blue blinking lights holds on to a seat, while a cup and a pencil float in the air and a huge swirling black hole fills the front window.
scenes.2: On green grass beside a small white spaceship in a sunny town on Earth, a young woman pilot with short silver hair in a red flight suit hands a white medicine box to a smiling family, while a round little robot with a dome head and blue blinking lights carries a stack of boxes and its blue lights blink happily.

alt.1: The cockpit shakes as the black hole pulls the ship.
alt.2: Aria gives the medicine to a family on Earth.
alt.cover: The spaceship swings around the edge of the black hole.
